properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] DNS Private Resolver: Must Be Linked to Hub VNet
properties.description: Audits Azure DNS Private Resolver instances that are not deployed within the hub virtual network. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) and secure name/address resolution (SC-20). DNS Private Resolver must be integrated with the hub VNet to ensure all DNS queries are resolved within the trusted network boundary and not routed over public internet paths.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for resolvers not linked to hub VNet. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
List of hub VNet resource IDs that the DNS Private Resolver must be deployed into.
